sentences.text: The WBISAITo scheme is a welfare initiative launched by the Government of West Bengal.
It aims to provide financial assistance to small and marginal farmers in the state.
The objective is to enhance agricultural productivity and ensure food security.
The scheme offers direct cash transfers to eligible farmers.
This financial support helps in purchasing seeds fertilizers and other agricultural inputs.
Eligibility is primarily based on land ownership and income criteria.
Small and marginal farmers with landholdings up to two hectares can apply.
The application process involves filling out a form available at local agricultural offices.
Farmers may also apply online through the official government portal.
The scheme is implemented by the Department of Agriculture Government of West Bengal.
Assistance is provided annually based on the agricultural cycle.
The scheme aims to uplift the economic condition of farmers in the region.
It also promotes sustainable agricultural practices among beneficiaries.
Regular monitoring and evaluation are conducted to assess the impact of the scheme.
